translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for sprains, bruises, muscle pain, pain from fractures, stiff shoulders, frostbite, joint pain, low back pain and muscle fatigue.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; moist areas, dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like, and wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with severe moist skin or erosion; women who are pregnant or may be pregnant; breastfeeding women. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. If your symptoms do not improve after several days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; itching. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
